description: This Python script is designed for manipulating TP-Link 2022 images, specifically creating, extracting, and analyzing images in a particular binary format used on TP-Link devices around 2022. It includes functions to decode headers, extract sections, create images with specific sections like support lists and software versions, and handle image files.

methods.name: decode_header(datafile)
methods.description: Reads and decodes the header of a TP-Link 2022 image from a file, returning a dictionary with rootfs size, number of items, and section details.

methods.name: extract(datafile)
methods.description: Extracts sections from the TP-Link 2022 image file to separate binary files and saves leftover data.

methods.name: get_section_contents(section)
methods.description: Retrieves the content of a section based on its size, either from a 'data' field or from a file.

methods.name: write_image(output_image, header)
methods.description: Constructs and writes a TP-Link 2022 image file from a given header dictionary, including headers, sections, and checksums.

methods.name: encode_soft_verson()
methods.description: Produces a packed binary string representing a version; purpose unclear but included in image creation.

methods.name: create_image(output_image, root, support)
methods.description: Creates a TP-Link 2022 image file from a root filesystem file and a support string, adding support list and software version sections.

methods.name: main(args)
methods.description: Main entry point for script execution; manages command line arguments for analyzing, extracting, or creating images.
